title: Careers
intro: We hire engineers, designers and operators who like owning hard problems end to end. If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

sections.heading: How to apply
sections.body: Email your CV and a short note about the work you are proudest of to contact@techlio.co. Tell us which role or area you are interested in.

sections.heading: What we look for
sections.body: Senior judgment, clear writing and a habit of finishing. Experience with AI systems helps, and so does a record of shipping software that real users depend on.

sections.heading: Where we work
sections.body: Our team is based in Lahore, Pakistan, and works with clients across the US, UK and Europe.
